(begin (dialog '(("/" "Nobody knows what the writing on this rock means, it is not even known who wrote it."))) (define id "029-tree-story") (if (get id) (dialog '(("/" "Do you want to hear the legend of this tree again?"))) (dialog '(("/" "Are you interested to learn about the legend of this tree?")))) (answer id '(("Yes please" . #t) ("No thanks" . #f))) (wait) (if (get id) (dialog '(("/" "A looong time ago, way before the arrival of the King of Evil, there was a devastating war in this area.
Everything was razed to the ground.
Nothing and no one remained, except this tree.
It is said that this tree encloses all the souls who left us.
It has the peculiarity of losing its leaves in spring and blooming in the other seasons.
Every spring the souls leave this tree to make other plants bloom and then, at the end of spring, the souls return to flourish again this tree.
That's all I know about this tree.
I hope to live long enough to see the end of this winter season which has persisted for more than 60 years now."))) (dialog '(("/" "Ok, it was a long and boring story after all.")))))
